FIELDS.NAME: Home & Harmony Furniture
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Home & Harmony Furniture is a retail establishment specializing in a wide range of quality furniture for residential and commercial spaces. Our operations primarily involve the sale of ready-to-assemble and pre-assembled furniture, including sofas, dining sets, beds, and office furnishings. We focus on providing our customers with excellent service and knowledgeable staff who help guide their purchasing decisions. 

In addition to our retail offerings, we provide delivery and installation services to ensure customer satisfaction. Our dedicated installation team comprises trained employees who adhere to strict safety protocols, thus minimizing any risks associated with the delivery process. We do not engage in any on-site woodworking, manufacturing, or refinishing operations, which helps us maintain a safer and more controlled environment.

Our store operates from a secure, monitored facility equipped with fire sprinklers and compliance with all local zoning and fire regulations, ensuring the safety of our inventory and customers. We aim to create a pleasant shopping experience for our customers while upholding high standards of operational safety. 

We do not specialize in creating custom pieces that involve on-site woodworking or refinishing to meet our customers' unique design preferences.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: No losses reported. Business operations do not involve on-site woodworking, manufacturing, or refinishing operations.
